to.description: Recipient. E.164 phone (e.g. +14165550100) or `sms:+E164` JID. Plain digits without a country code are rejected — the gateway requires E.164.

text.description: Message body. Carriers split SMS at 160 chars (or 70 chars for non-GSM-7 alphabets); long messages get concatenated server-side. The gateway doesn't truncate.
